400.error: A pairing code grants either "full" or "chat". Leave the scope out for full control, which is what the Mac's own Settings window offers by default.

403.error: Only this Mac can mint a pairing code.

409.error: Silicon Buddy's tailnet listener is not up, so a pairing code would have nowhere to dial. Turn Silicon Buddy on in Settings → Silicon Buddy on the Mac and wait for it to report an address.

411.error: This server needs a Content-Length. Chunked bodies are not read.

413.error: That request body is larger than this device may send (4194304 bytes).

summary: Mint the pairing code the Mac's own Settings window would show.
